name: Assorted security testing and audit tools
need: Admins and testers want various tools: SQL injection scanners, RDP brute forcing, honeypots, config compliance and file change tracking.
reason: Unrelated tool requests grouped by the word tool.

name: Generic public security software procurement
need: European public bodies issue tenders for unspecified security, data security and antivirus software packages.
reason: Tender titles without a specific need; no single product fits.

name: Mixed web, certificate and phishing concerns
need: Site owners and admins ask about certificate automation, phishing sites, DNS hijacking, hosting malware and server hardening.
reason: Certificates, phishing reports, hosting and hardening are distinct needs.

name: Assorted feature requests mentioning security
need: Users of various projects request unrelated features such as CSP-compatible reCAPTCHA, incident response automation and safe embeds.
reason: Unrelated project feature requests sharing surface words.

name: Vulnerability scanning of software dependencies
need: Development teams struggle to detect and update vulnerable dependencies, sub-dependencies and container images in their CI pipelines.
reason: Most ask for automated dependency or image vulnerability checks.

name: Mixed email phishing, archiving and privacy
need: Email admins face phishing and spoofed mail, but others need message archiving, attachment blocking or a secure provider.
reason: Phishing defense mixed with archiving, DLP and provider choice.

name: Security compliance audits for small businesses
need: Small businesses without IT staff struggle to meet SOC 2, ISO 27001 or customer security audit demands.
reason: Most describe small firms facing security audits or standards; phone posts off.

name: Assorted CLI automation and secure defaults
need: Developers and pentesters ask about automating Metasploit, ZAP and Nikto, strict CSP builds and safer default configurations.
reason: Fuzzing automation, headers, CSP and defaults are different needs.

name: Achieving and maintaining PCI DSS compliance
need: Merchants and admins struggle to pass PCI compliance scans and assessments and find tools to fix failures.
reason: All statements concern passing PCI compliance requirements.

name: PCI scan failures from package versions
need: Server admins fail PCI ASV scans flagging Apache, PHP, OpenSSH or OpenSSL versions despite distro-backported patches.
reason: Almost all describe version-based PCI scan failures on Linux servers.

name: Assorted encryption and key handling questions
need: Users ask about TLS filtering, constant-time math, key rotation, encrypted email and multi-key encryption tools.
reason: Encryption topics with unrelated underlying needs.

name: Outsourced computer audit and testing services
need: European public bodies seek external providers for computer audit and testing services.
reason: All are tenders for computer audit and testing services.

name: Assorted complaints about security difficulty
need: People raise physical server room access, yum security updates, poor company security, hardware keys and password hashing.
reason: Physical, patching, cultural and crypto topics share only vague words.

name: User activity and logon auditing
need: Admins need to audit user logons, password changes, root activity and policy exemptions across Windows, Unix and Office365 without centralized logging.
reason: Most ask to track and report user account activity.

name: Logging user sessions and logins
need: Admins want simple ways to log and report terminal, SSH and login sessions of users on their servers.
reason: Most ask for user session or login logging; three off-topic.

name: Isolating systems to reduce PCI scope
need: Businesses handling card data struggle to isolate terminals, apps and containers to meet PCI DSS requirements.
reason: All concern structuring card-handling environments for PCI compliance.

name: Ransomware detection and recovery on Windows
need: Small Windows networks hit by ransomware struggle to prevent, detect and recover encrypted files on file servers.
reason: All describe ransomware infection, prevention or recovery on Windows networks.

name: Audit trails across disparate systems
need: Admins want access audit logs from email appliances, USB drives, CRM, SQL Server, MongoDB and AD groups.
reason: Shared audit wish, but each system needs a different solution.
